# Accelerate
> AI strategy and systems for small businesses. We build and manage AI-powered automation for lead capture, customer engagement, content, and reporting.

## Services
- [AI Strategy & Roadmap](/services#strategy): Custom AI implementation plan with ROI projections and tool recommendations
- [Workflow Automation](/services#automation): Automate follow-ups, scheduling, invoicing, and internal workflows
- [Sales & Marketing Automation](/services#sales): Pipeline management, email campaigns, inquiry scoring, and follow-up sequences
- [Customer Engagement](/services#engagement): AI-powered chat, automated booking, review management, and re-engagement campaigns
- [Content Creation](/services#content): SEO blog posts, social media, email newsletters on a consistent schedule
- [Data & Reporting](/services#reporting): Custom dashboards, weekly digests, pipeline tracking, and trend analysis

## Industries
- [Home Services](/industries/home-services): Roofing, HVAC, plumbing, electrical — AI receptionist, estimate tools, follow-up automation

- [Real Estate](/industries/real-estate): Agents, brokerages, property management — instant response, long-term nurture, listing automation
